description: Post-orchestrator hook registry. The GSD global hooks and every project-installed subsystem hook family (appsec/qa/uiux/discoverability/i2r) were removed on 2026-08-25 together with their orchestrators; the pre-removal taxonomy lives at tag pre-orchestrator-removal. What remains is a small always-on set plus dormant opt-ins.

global_live.description: Registered in ~/.claude/settings.json. Fires on every session, no project config required.

hooks.name: ledger-autolog.js
hooks.purpose: Append machine trail to .harness/runs.jsonl via orchestrator-runtime/shared/run-ledger.js (CLAUDE.md 0.7 layer)

hooks.name: scripts/hooks/config-protection.js
hooks.purpose: Block edits that weaken linter/formatter configs

hooks.name: scripts/hooks/post-edit-format.js
hooks.purpose: Auto-format edited files with the project formatter

hooks.name: scripts/hooks/design-quality-check.js
hooks.purpose: Warn when frontend edits drift toward generic template UI

library_modules.description: Shared helper modules; not hooks, not registered in settings.json.

dormant_opt_in.description: Hooks present on disk but intentionally not registered in settings.json. Available for opt-in but suppressed by default.

entries.name: report-gate.js
entries.reason: Deterministic completion-report gate (Stop, HARD block on a sub-threshold closing report after a non-trivial turn). Kept opt-in — the CLAUDE.md 0.5 report discipline runs on instruction alone and has proven sufficient.
entries.opt_in_via: add to ~/.claude/settings.json Stop; tune via CLAUDE_REPORT_GATE_MINCHARS/MINEDITS, disable via CLAUDE_REPORT_GATE_OFF=1

entries.name: plan-card-reminder.js
entries.reason: Deterministic plan-preview-card reminder (PreToolUse[Agent|Workflow], SOFT — never blocks). Kept opt-in — the CLAUDE.md 0.6 plan-card discipline runs on instruction alone.
entries.opt_in_via: add to ~/.claude/settings.json PreToolUse[Agent|Workflow]; disable via CLAUDE_PLAN_CARD_OFF=1

entries.name: ledger-reminder.js
entries.reason: Durable-LEDGER reminder (Stop, SOFT one-shot). Unwired 2026-07-24: /preclear reliably reconciles the ledger at session end. File kept on disk as opt-in.
entries.opt_in_via: add to ~/.claude/settings.json Stop; disable via CLAUDE_LEDGER_REMINDER_OFF=1

deprecated.description: Hook families removed with their orchestrators on 2026-08-25 so audit tools can flag legacy references. Full lists at tag pre-orchestrator-removal.
